description: TU Delft and project partners provide a drilling report for DAPGEO-02, a multi-purpose research borehole installed at Delftse Hout from February to May 2022. It is described as the third of four seismic-monitoring locations for the TU Delft campus geothermal research project. The source connects it to a monitoring system around a planned geothermal doublet and to related borehole, CT-scan, sonic and NMR datasets. Coverage: February to May 2022. Access: public native metadata identifies this release and its stated formats. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current distribution access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The report documents installation and system context; current operation, planned-doublet status and borehole findings were not independently checked. The source-declared TU Delft repository DOI is compared as an equivalent-identity lead, without byte equivalence. The PDF report was not acquired. Simulation use concerns geothermal subsurface geometry and monitoring context, interpreted from the documented borehole and seismic-monitoring purpose.
